requirements.body: The bidder must state how many hospital beds it can deliver within 90 days.
The bidder must attach a regulatory certificate for the bed model.
Evaluation will prefer a clear delivery statement over an unsupported one.

paragraphs: This draft uses only the fictional supplier note and the fictional invitation.
The supplier note records a bed width of 950 mm.
The invitation asks for a delivery quantity and a regulatory certificate. Neither is in the supplier note, so this draft does not state them.
